caption:
Rank your leads wrong and the hottest one waits behind the coldest.

Most shops answer every channel on the same three-hour delay.

Sort inbound by signal strength instead:

1. Phone call: highest intent, answer in minutes
2. Form or quote request: same window as a call
3. DM: real intent, respond inside the hour
4. Public comment: lowest intent, reply for the crowd then move to DM

Leads answered inside five minutes close at nearly double the rate of the ones who wait, according to widely cited lead-response research. Rank matters as much as speed.

See every channel routed into one inbox.
